market_specific_notes: Houston shoppers often compare raw price too early instead of comparing full-process clarity first.
The strongest local differentiator is whether the office explains timing and add-on costs before payment.
local_vetting_points: Ask whether the quote is exam-only or full-process through packet completion.
Ask whether labs and vaccines are handled onsite or referred out.
Ask what usually causes packet delays after the visit.
Ask whether the clinic explains how correction visits or missing documents change the timeline.
typical_cost_ranges: Houston quotes usually diverge when vaccines, labs, translation help, or repeat visits are missing from the headline number.
The cleanest comparison is total expected cost through packet completion, not the cheapest exam-only number.
payment_options: Ask what is paid at booking, at the visit, and at any follow-up.
Confirm whether add-on vaccine or lab charges are quoted in advance.
wait_time_notes: Houston timing often changes when outside labs or missing vaccine records turn one visit into two.
availability_notes: A fast booking only helps if the office can still explain realistic packet timing.
named_resources_or_providers: Civil surgeon locator confirmation and clinic review check for repeat comments on turnaround.
city_intro_override: Houston comparisons work better when every clinic is forced into the same comparison: what is included, what happens if records or vaccines are missing, and when the sealed packet is actually ready.

primary_city_decision_block.title: Houston civil surgeon comparison checklist
items: Ask what is included in the quoted number and what usually becomes an add-on.
Ask whether vaccines and labs are handled onsite or turn the exam into a second stop.
Ask when the sealed packet is typically ready if records are complete versus incomplete.
Ask whether the office explains the full exam-to-packet sequence before taking payment.
Ask whether the office can compare same-day appointment availability against realistic packet completion timing.

heading: Houston USCIS medical exam comparison: what changes the quote and the packet timeline
i693_document_requirements: Bring ID, immigration paperwork, and all vaccination records you can gather before the appointment.
vaccination_handling_notes: Houston shoppers should confirm whether missing vaccines are solved onsite or through a separate outside step.
bilingual_support: If language support matters, confirm it for both intake and document review.
appointment_booking_notes: Ask the office to explain booking, exam, labs, vaccines, and packet release in one sequence.
If the office advertises speed, ask whether that means same-day exam, same-day completion, or only same-day scheduling.
